issue: Row count variance (-776 rows vs 100,000 spec) & 814 duplicate review_ids
evidence: File has 99,224 rows. 814 review_ids appear multiple times. 547 orders have >1 review.
impact: If joined blindly, orders with multiple reviews will duplicate order rows and distort financial sums.
recommended_fix: Module 2 must enforce deduplication to 1 review per order_id by selecting the latest review_answer_timestamp.

issue: Extreme coordinate multiplicity (up to 1,146 rows per zip prefix) & spatial coordinate outliers
evidence: 19,015 zip prefixes across 1,000,163 rows. 261,831 exact duplicate rows. 29 lat and 37 lng coordinates outside Brazil bounds.
impact: Merging raw geolocation to customers/sellers causes massive Cartesian row explosion (up to 1,146x).
recommended_fix: Module 2 must build an aggregated centroid lookup table (mean lat/lng per zip_prefix) clipped to Brazil bounds.

issue: Financial discrepancy between items (price+freight) and payments (payment_value)
impact: Downstream revenue calculations could yield different totals depending on whether items or payments is used.
recommended_fix: Define Order Gross Merchandise Value (GMV = price + freight) vs Order Settlement Value (Payment Value) in KPI layer.

issue: Multi-item orders (9,803 orders with 13,984 additional item rows)
evidence: 112,650 item rows across 98,666 orders (up to 21 items in a single order).
impact: Direct join between orders and items will destroy the atomic order grain.
recommended_fix: Pre-aggregate items to order_id grain (sum price, sum freight, count items, dominant category) before joining.

issue: Multi-tender payment rows (2,961 orders with 4,446 additional payment rows)
evidence: 103,886 payment rows across 99,440 orders (up to 29 payment records for a single order).
impact: Direct join between orders and payments will multiply order rows.
recommended_fix: Pre-aggregate payments to order_id grain (sum payment_value, max installments, primary payment_type) before joining.

issue: Non-delivered orders (2,963 orders) & conditional timestamp missingness
evidence: 2,963 orders are not delivered (canceled, unavailable, shipped, etc.); 2,965 missing customer delivery dates.
impact: Calculating delivery duration or delay on non-delivered orders causes nulls or invalid negative durations.
recommended_fix: Strictly filter order_status == 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date.notnull() for delivery KPIs.

evidence: Products table has 73 categories; translation table has 71.
impact: Left join produces null category names in English for products in these 2 categories.
recommended_fix: Provide explicit fallback mapping dictionary during category cleaning in Module 3.

issue: Unverified secondary claims in external narrative (e.g. 4.5 to 3.9 review drop, 40.3% late rate)
evidence: External blog posts and Kaggle notebooks have contradictory and unverified figures.
impact: Risk of confirmation bias if secondary claims are accepted without direct calculation.
recommended_fix: Tag all external claims as UNVERIFIED ANECDOTAL; rely solely on our direct code execution.
